en.headline: Four arrested over alleged drug deliveries to Princess Margaret Hospital wards
en.dek: Police say two men delivered narcotics to inpatients after staff found two female patients with suspected dangerous drugs; about HK$20,000 worth of ketamine, heroin and cocaine seized.
body: Police arrested four people after Princess Margaret Hospital staff reported that two female inpatients were suspected of possessing dangerous drugs. Officers from the Sham Shui Po District Special Duty Squad investigated and found that narcotics were being delivered directly to a ward.

Operations between 29 August and 3 September led to the arrest of two local men aged 21 and 22 on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs, and two local women aged 42 and 63 on suspicion of possession. The 22-year-old man was also arrested for failing to produce an identity document. Officers seized about 30 grams of suspected ketamine, 53 packets of suspected heroin and a small quantity of suspected cocaine, with a total estimated value of about HK$20,000.

The two men remained in custody and were expected to be charged with trafficking and to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on 5 September. The two women were released on bail pending further inquiries and required to report in early October. Police condemned the delivery of drugs into hospital wards, saying it endangered patients and disrupted hospital operations.

zh.headline: 瑪嘉烈醫院病房涉運毒 警拘四男女
zh.dek: 院方發現兩名女病人藏有懷疑危險藥物，警方揭有人運送毒品入病房，檢獲市值約2萬元氯胺酮、海洛英及可卡因。
body: 警方接獲瑪嘉烈醫院職員報案，指發現兩名留院女病人懷疑藏有危險藥物。深水埗警區特別職務隊調查後發現有不法分子運送毒品至醫院病房，並於8月29日至9月3日採取行動。
行動中拘捕兩名21歲及22歲本地男子，涉嫌販運危險藥物；以及兩名42歲及63歲本地女子，涉嫌藏有危險藥物。22歲男子同時涉嫌未能出示身份證明文件。檢獲約30克懷疑氯胺酮、53粒懷疑海洛英及少量懷疑可卡因，總市值約2萬元。
兩名男子被扣留，暫控販運危險藥物罪，案件於9月5日在九龍城裁判法院提堂；兩名女子獲准保釋候查，須於10月上旬報到。警方譴責不法分子運送毒品至病房，罔顧病人安全及影響醫院運作。
